gap_description.definition: The x-axes of the three main plots show continuous time scales (regular tick spacing) with separate inset axes used for early-time zooms; there is no visual axis break marker (zigzag or diagonal) indicating a discontinuity.
The y-axes show normalized intensity on a continuous scale (no skipped numeric ranges or break markers). Insets display zoomed y-ranges as separate small plots, not as a broken main axis.

justify_why_gaps_are_missing.justification: Tick marks and plotted data on the main x-axes are spaced continuously with no sudden jump in numeric labels; early-time detail is presented as separate inset plots rather than by breaking the main axis, so no axis break indicator is needed.
Y-axis tick labeling appears continuous and proportional; the figure uses insets to show a different y-range (zoom), not an interrupted axis, therefore no axis-break symbol is required.
